Codex adversarial review: approve with notes (both findings addressed in 4fe68f0).

1. [fixed] Ref doc inconsistency — B was listed under §4.2(e) 'neither' group and algorithm section still said 'NOT set'. Moved to §4.2(d) finite-difference list, fixed algorithm section.
2. [fixed] Golden data did not stress r-clamp boundary — added 12 near-polar cases (geolat=±78) where |r|→0.997. Note: mathematical analysis confirms |r|>1 is geometrically unreachable (ascendant declination is bounded by 90-geolat), so the clamp is a floating-point safety net only.
